comment: The features ui-look.js shows, one entry each: what it is, and the settings, commands and views of package.json that belong to it. Every step of ui-look.js names the features it shows. A feature that cannot be shown in a window says why in notShown and needs no step. A feature that works through Agent Plus also names, under agentPlus, the settings, commands and views of Agent Plus's package.json it uses; agentPlusOther lists the rest of Agent Plus's, with why they are not this extension's. window names the steps of ui.js, the window test CI runs, that assert a feature in code; relay names the options of the steward's script (claude-plugin/agent-work-plan/hooks/steward-relay.py, send being the message with no option) that belong to a feature. stewardActions lists the features that are something a steward does or is told. test/check.js checks that every setting, command and view is listed here exactly once, those of Agent Plus against the Agent Plus it can find, that every other feature has a step, that every option of the steward's script belongs to exactly one feature, that every steward action has a step and a window step, and that every window step named is a step of ui.js.

features.what: A time on each of your messages and on every block of a reply, start->end on a tool call; Claude Code's own message times are hidden while these show.
On the first row of each reply: how long the turn took, the share of the context window in use, the cost so far, the model and its effort.
Turning off and on the times, the reply figures and the sub-agent tags at once, without a reload.
Your own messages: a bar down their left edge, and a text color when one is set.
Rows that came from a sub-agent carry a tag with its task.
A footer control that shows all rows, only the main thread, or only one sub-agent.
The rail on the panel's right edge (to the top, previous, the list, next, to the bottom) and the list of your messages behind it, with times, a filter box and a highlighted row on hover.
A footer button that turns Claude Code's Focus view on and off; Focus view hides thinking and tool calls.
While Focus view is on and a turn runs, the working line says which tool ran last or is running, and for how long.
This extension's footer buttons beside Claude Code's own, and the hover label of each.
The round usage meter stays in the footer; resting on it shows a breakdown with what the work plan added.
The footer button that mutes the end-of-turn sounds, and its two states.
The footer's info button and its box: session id, process id, starting folder, transcript and its size, token mode.

An image a reply gives by path is drawn at most 640 by 480 px; a click shows a scaled-down one large and a click or Escape closes it; an image at a web address stays a link; switched off, an image shows as its text and path.

The footer's button that counts background work, its dot green while any of that work runs, and the map it opens: claude -p workers, commands left running detached, scheduled prompts, background sessions, and the conversation's own row with the dot its tab has.

The claude --bg sessions a conversation started: counted on its Agents button, whose dot is green while one runs, listed in its agent map with each state in its own colour, and kept once done, with the result.
A message from another conversation that got only a quiet reply (a dash) leaves nothing on screen: no dot, no fold row, no blank line.
A warning the page shows when its lookups stop finding the panel's messages; a working panel shows none.
A filled green dot on a Claude Code tab's logo, at its top right, and at the start of its session list rows, while a turn runs.
A green ring, hollow in the middle, on a Claude Code tab's logo and at the start of its session list rows, once the turn has ended and only background work still runs.
A filled red dot on a Claude Code tab's logo and at the start of its session list rows, while Claude Code waits for you to answer a permission prompt or a choice.
No dot on a Claude Code tab's logo and none on its session list rows once the conversation has stopped and nothing runs; no blue dot anywhere.

A white envelope (U+2709) at the end of a Claude Code tab's title, after a steward's crown, and at the right end of its session list rows, while the conversation has a reply not read yet; it goes once the conversation is shown.
OPEN SESSIONS at the top of the session list: the conversations open in this window, with their status dots.
RECENTLY CLOSED above OPEN SESSIONS: the conversations whose tabs were closed, folded until opened.
New in tab and New in sidebar in place of New session, and Resume in tab and Resume in sidebar in a closed conversation's menu.
Resting on a session list row shows its group and its session id.
The session list's search also finds a conversation by four or more characters of its session id.
The dates of a conversation's first and last messages after its last-active time on each session list row.
A pin at the start of each session list row, hollow until clicked, purple when pinned.
Text color in a conversation's right-click menu, and the title drawn in the picked color.
After a right-click menu item has run, exactly one row of the session list looks selected.
Delete session... in an archived conversation's menu, and the confirmation that names the conversation.
Delete session... on a conversation open in a window, this one or another, deletes nothing and says which window has it open.
Sessions started with claude --bg or claude -p are left out of the session list.
The Steward panel at the bottom of the window: the conversations open in windows, with ticks.
A steward's tab title and session list rows show one crown before its title.

Renaming a steward through Claude Code's own rename: the box holds no mark, whatever is typed the name is stored without crown, envelope or bell, and the tab and the list still show exactly one crown, first.
Renaming a conversation with a reply not read yet through its session list row's rename box: envelopes and crowns typed into the name are not stored, and it still shows exactly one envelope, last.
A steward passes a message on: Claude Code Plus types it into the managed conversation in the window that shows it, which sends it as your own message.
A steward renames a conversation it manages, and Claude Code records the new title.
A steward closes a managed conversation's editor tab, deleting nothing; one that is working, waiting for an answer or running background work only once the user has confirmed.
A steward starts a new conversation in the window that has a folder open, sends it the first message and then manages it; it can list the open windows and their folders.

A steward opens a conversation that no window shows, in an editor tab of the window whose first folder is the one Claude Code keeps it under, passes it a message and has it ticked; not while a window shows it or another process runs it, and in no other window.
window: a steward reopening a conversation in the window of its folder

features.what: A managed conversation hands something that belongs elsewhere to its steward, which gets it as a notice that is not the user's message; on native Windows the answer says the steward cannot be reached.
Claude Code Plus tells a steward, in a notice that is not the user's message, when a conversation it manages starts waiting for the user; not on native Windows.
A steward's link to a conversation, in a reply or on a Steward panel row, brings that conversation's tab to the front in whichever window shows it; a link to one open nowhere says so.
A title too long for its row ends in an ellipsis in the session list and the Steward panel, and the envelope stays in view after it, at the row's end.
In a light theme the envelope is drawn in its one-colour text form, readable on the light background, on the tab title and the session list rows.
Agent Plus's work plan view in the side bar, showing the conversation's plan, read from the plan files this extension's plugin keeps.
Agent Plus's Conversations view at the bottom of the window, listing Claude Code conversations and their questions, and the Answer view for one question.
An answer sent from Agent Plus's Answer view arrives in the conversation as your own message.

Agent Plus's notice, with Open and Dismiss, when a Claude Code conversation not in front starts to wait for you or stops with a reply not read yet, and its count of those conversations in the status bar; none for the conversation in front.
Agent Plus: Show Status names this extension's Claude Code source and the folder of its plans.
Agent Plus's token mode entry in the status bar; the info box names the mode.
Claude Code Plus: Settings opens VS Code's settings at this extension's own.
Claude Code Plus: Show Status says whether Claude Code's two files are patched, and the token mode.
Claude Code Plus: Show How Long Opening a Panel Took shows the recorded panel-opening times.
Installing the work plan plugin again, and the confirmation before it stops being loaded.
This extension's additions in a narrow editor and a narrow side bar.
Everything this extension draws, in a light theme.
A short sound when a turn finishes, permission is asked or Claude asks a question.
features.notShown: a sound; the mute button that controls it is shown under chime-mute

features.what: Hooks that put the plan's open rows in front of Claude every turn, and the offer of a plan to a long conversation without one.
features.notShown: text added to Claude's context; nothing is drawn

features.what: Each conversation is asked to keep a brief of itself, which Agent Plus shows on a click.
features.notShown: the request is text in Claude's context, and the brief exists only once a live model has written one

features.what: Claude is told the time zone the panel is read in.
The conversation is told when a command it left running detached stops, and when a background session ends.
How long a pin keeps a conversation from Claude Code's transcript cleanup while no window is open.
features.notShown: changes file times on disk; the pin on screen looks the same

features.what: Claude Code tabs that VS Code did not restore after a lost remote connection are opened again.
features.notShown: needs a window that lost its remote connection; this window is local

features.what: Background Claude Code tabs load when the window starts, not when first clicked.
features.notShown: happens during start-up, each tab in front for a moment; afterwards the window looks the same either way

features.what: A mark on a conversation that runs in two Claude Code processes at once, on its session list rows and its Steward panel row, and the Steward panel's Stop the old process button, which stops the older one.
window: a conversation run by two processes

features.what: Claude Code Plus: Remove from Claude Code restores Claude Code's original files.
features.notShown: it needs a reload, after which the remaining steps would run without the patch, and it rewrites the shared cache's copy of Claude Code; the window test, whose copy is its own, removes it last

agentPlusOther.why: VS Code's own limit on requests in flight for webview tabs, which Agent Plus edits in VS Code's files; nothing of this extension's
